test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Shovana Narayan was awarded which of the following awards in 2013?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Guru Deba Prasad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Kathak dancer Shovana Narayan** is also a career officer for the **Indian Audit and Accounts Service.**
 
• **She has received Padma Shri and performs both in India and abroad.**
 
• Her mentor was Birju Maharaj.
 
• **In 2013, Guru Deba Prasad honors were given to Shovana Narayan.**
 
• Her efforts to combine Kathak with other important dance genres including Tap dancing, Spanish Flamenco, and Western Classical Ballet are extraordinary.
 
• **Shovana is a well-known author and social critic.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Guru Deba Prasad Award**

 
 
• **​Guru Debaprasad Das' contribution to the resurgence of Odissi dance will live on in memory forever.**
 
• **This award festival's goals are to honour illustrious Gurus **and performers in the fields of classical dance and music, as well as to display and promote **Odissi dance, a hybrid gharana of Guru Debaprasad that captures the essence of tribal and traditional traditions.**
 
• Since the** three streams of folk, tribal, and traditional Odissi dances are combined in Guruji's Gharana **and frequently seen in **Guru Gajendra Panda's choreography,** mirroring both the sensual lasya aspect and the dynamic tandava part, the name **TRIDHARA for the institute is highly appropriate.**
